owner: Odessy (product declaration). The Harness side owns the runtime; this file is the declaration the Odessy build and installer read.
purpose: One repository-owned declaration of the tested Harness runtime distribution, the SDK (declared, not used), the plugin closure that ships with the Odessy package, the platform/architecture requirements and the licences. `pin.py` derives its enforced constants from this file, so there is no second copy to drift.

runtime.transport: acp v1 over stdio (newline-delimited JSON-RPC 2.0 on stdin/stdout)

win_amd64.url_source: PyPI JSON API for deepseek-harness-runtime-bin 0.2.1rc2 (re-read 2026-11-10); the digest it reports equals this declaration

manylinux_2_28_aarch64.note: Downloaded and hashed only. Never launched on this host; a Jetson/Linux qualification is a later installed gate, not evidence recorded here.

sidecars.purpose: The runtime's own ripgrep used by its search rows. Shipped because the narrow profile disables those rows; the file is still verified so a staged payload is either the reviewed set or refused.

The runtime's own declaration of optional npm payloads (LibreOffice kit, pnpm). Recorded so the absence of a download at launch can be asserted, and so this file is not mistaken for something Odessy fetched.

bundled_not_used: win-x64/office-skills/** (skill text for the office rows this profile disables)
win-x64.embedded_runtime_note: The executable is a self-contained Node single-executable application; it does not expose a Node interpreter, so the separately launched tool server uses the installer's private node-runtime instead of this binary. Measured, not assumed: `--help`/`--version` accept no script or eval argument and the tool pipeline is spawned from `node-runtime/node.exe`.

licenses.license: third-party notices for the bundled Node payload

python_dependencies.note: Wheels the runtime-bin distribution pulls in, recorded with their digests so an installer resolves the same set. Installing them belongs to prompt 14.

sdk.note: The production adapter speaks ACP to the executable and never imports this SDK. It is declared so that a future use cannot silently pick a different version; pyproject.toml does not depend on it.

bundles.name: @odessy/dsh-stream-bridge
bundles.purpose: Forwards the pin's existing `agent/assistant-stream` frames, answers its existing `user-questions` seam, and reports the tools the runtime actually attached (read-only `ctx.tools.schemas` names), all over one token-authenticated loopback socket. No inference, no agent loop, no transcript, no tool registration.
bundles.absent_effect: The engine degrades to settlement-only text and no clarification tool; session creation still succeeds.

mounted_rows.name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-ask-user
mounted_rows.purpose: The model-facing clarification tool; it asks a human and returns the answer as an ordinary tool result.

development_toolchain.purpose: `dsh plugin add` shells out to pnpm. The composed profile is what ships, so this is a build/developer prerequisite only.

profile.name: acp
profile.why_not_plugin_add: `dsh plugin add` runs pnpm, and a 273 MB offline installer must not require a package manager or a network fetch. The composed result is three small deterministic files plus a byte-identical copy of the packaged bundle, so Odessy can write it directly and verify every byte against this inventory.

package.json.purpose: The profile package: its bundle list is what the runtime composes.

cordis.yml.purpose: Profile root: an empty entry list; the tree is composed as patches.

cordis.patch.yml.purpose: The user's own patch layer, left empty so a local edit survives.

never_overwritten: profiles/<profile>/package.json once it names additional bundles

windows-x64.qualification: Source tests; a complete role-aware installer chain into a fresh isolated root (declared Node 22.23.0, bundled CPython 3.12.13, executable digest matched); an installed payload from a previous build of this source set driven through the HTTP application (report 14.rev1 7.6-7.7: streaming, approved and denied consent, bundled Node tool, clarification, Stop, restore, no leftover child); the wheel closure now declares fastapi/uvicorn with hashes, so a packaged service can serve /v1. Payload and NSIS are rebuilt from this tree (report 14.rev3). Not qualified: native setup click-through, end-user desktop (prompt 16), Linux/Jetson (17-20).

declared_not_qualified.linux-arm64: Runtime wheel recorded; no launch, no confinement measurement and no installed gate performed on this host (prompt 17-20 for remote directions).

confinement.owner: Odessy providers keep the dimensions the pin cannot express; see doc/reports/08.md and harness/sandbox.py.

procedure: Record both wheel digests and the new executable digest here and in pin.py's derived constants.
Re-read every observed shape in the integration contract.
Re-run the installed qualification before any default change.
